scope: Full native filtered MaleCNS graph and unmodified FlyDrones LIF runtime; engineering qualification, not biological response validation or drone control
selection: Protocol chosen before the full-network results; upstream default minimum 3 synapses, all native retained neurons, no subgraph reduction
shuffle_policy: Within the observed IDs of each eye only, preserving each tick's rates/multiset and all missing/out-of-field zeros
disconnected_policy: Same full neuron inventory and LIF equations, all synaptic weights zero; never counted as a full-connectivity result

recorded.selection: First camera frame labelled phase 27, latest causal frame held at each 50 ms model tick
recorded.scope: Optional replay of existing D435 recording, not a new live acquisition or precise sensor/model synchronization

required_checks: Missing directions and outside-FOV inputs remain zero with a status
No-input/no-bias/no-noise from rest yields zero spikes
Disconnected control has no non-input spikes
Same-seed repeat gives identical per-neuron tick counts
Spatial shuffle preserves input multiset and is distinguishable in the response
report_even_if_negative: Existing capture replay and its limits
interpretation: Changed activity shows causal dependence within this simulator, not correct perception, receptive fields, behaviour, neural latency or biological equivalence. No output amplitude is fitted. Timing/memory are descriptive on the local machine, not performance thresholds.
